_comment: Base Object Swapper (BOS, D-6) VISIBLE in-game test. Swaps all 5 vanilla pine-forest trees -> a random aspen, both pure Skyrim.esm forms (no esp content needed). The central pine belt (Riverwood/Whiterun/Falkreath/Helgen) turns into golden Rift-style aspen forest -> unmistakable. BOS reads Data/MyTreeSwap_SWAP.ini regardless of the esp; the esp just carries the Skyrim.esm master. Requires po3_BaseObjectSwapper.dll. FormIDs verified against Skyrim.esm via `find`. Note: distant tree LOD billboards stay pine until you get close -> judge by the trees NEAR you.

groups._comment: Every base pine -> a random pick from the 6 aspen variants (BOS random-picks across a comma swap list).
